6752-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6752-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

4826-4863-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4826-4863-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
4826-4863-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Revolutionist and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1981-2415-6798-7918.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

225-2693-4693-5721.easyPrerequisites: Land cards in your graveyard and under your control can tap to add at least {4}{G}{B}.
225-2693-4693-5721.description:
Activate each untapped land you control by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it.
In response, activate Overgrown Estate repeatedly by sacrificing each land you control, gaining life each time.
Resolve the Aftermath Analyst ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
For each land that enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
In response activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Resolve one Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 5, untapping it.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 for each land that entered.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G}.
Aftermath Analyst enters, triggering itself, causing you to mill three cards.

2921-3249-5173-5334.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

2034-5003-7765.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Fantastic Four, adding {C}{C}.
When The Fantastic Four dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return The Fantastic Four from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When The Fantastic Four enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4289-6633-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4289-6633-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4289-6633-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2724-3080-4243-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Actiate Venser by putting two loyalty counters on him, exiling and returning (at end step) Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

913-2440-7546.description:
Cast Maestro's Gift from exile by paying {U}{R}, creating a token copy of Inspired Skypainter with haste that enters prepared.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Lizard or Wizard creature you control.
If needed, activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U/R}.
If needed, repeat step 3 an additional time.
Repeat.
913-2440-7546.notes: Mana needed drops significantly for each additional creature you control that is a Lizard or Wizard.

891-5617-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2464-3096-3832.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-3096-3832.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck is empty
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

4030-4331-4993-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3750-7017-7020.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Zuko.
You have at least five experience counters.
3750-7017-7020.description:
Declare Zuko as an attacker, triggering its ability, adding an amount of {R} equal to the number of experience counters you have.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Ozai.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

777-3532-3761-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
777-3532-3761-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

549-856-6748-6757-6797.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4929-5220-6247.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and High-Society Hunter.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Cryptic Trilobite from your library.
Repeat.

301-1099-2376.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1235-2556.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of the Smaug token and Mnemonic Wall with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token that died and the Mnemonic Wall token trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

4067-4823-4851-6281.description:
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Timeless Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Timeless Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat.

2450-5195-6259.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

647-3259-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1374-3626-4885-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3626-4885-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

3921-4659-5365-5494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
3921-4659-5365-5494.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

250-779-1272.description:
Activate Seismic Assault by discarding Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's third ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Seismic Assault ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1395-3536-5078.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2

1462-1748-2292.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1462-1748-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an additional creature.
When the creature dies as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Warehouse Tabby triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2198-2404-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2198-2404-4499.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.

215-2436-3014-4823.notablePrerequisites:
Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
Marwyn has a power of at least eight.
215-2436-3014-4823.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Cast Emerald Charm by paying {G}, untapping Marwyn.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Timeless Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Timeless Witness by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, returning Emerald Charm from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1124-2793-4050-4450-5089.manaNeeded: {3} on your first turn, with {8} available on all subsequent turns
1124-2793-4050-4450-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by exiling Ugin's Nexus, adding {1}.
Ugin's Nexus triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you to activate all planeswalker abilities an extra time this turn.
 Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1992-4050-4419.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-4050-4419.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter, adding one mana of any color.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Renata trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Knight token.
Repeat.
